outOfScope: Changing product WHAT or acceptance semantics to make an efficiency candidate pass.
Replacing Application domain authority, Oracle source ownership, Jev/QA judgment authority or EffectOperation truth.
Adopting Unreal Agent wholesale or treating its benchmark as ExHarness acceptance evidence.
constraints: Use the same model/version, task fixture, starting source, tool surface and resource ceiling for matched comparisons.
Treat Unreal Agent benchmark numbers as vendor evidence until independently reproduced; do not promote a design from external claims alone.
Record failed/retried calls and missing usage explicitly; unknown usage cannot be treated as zero.
Public GitHub implementation examples must have at least 1,000 stars at evidence check time or be called out as below the eligibility threshold.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: Instrument the current synchronous AgentRuntime first; a missing baseline is a blocker for promotion, not a reason to infer savings from Unreal Agent.
Pin Unreal Agent v0.2.0 / commit 1b9f778453f411c029b39b85102aaefb95e7e48d as the primary async reference and treat its published benchmark as vendor evidence.
Measure quality-adjusted cost and turns, not raw token reduction alone.
implementationSlices: Research current synchronous Core and pinned public references; isolate the smallest reusable mechanism and measurable gap.
Define exact durable contracts, provider/runtime boundaries, negative cases and compatibility fallback before implementation.
Implement or retain baseline only after a matched probe can distinguish quality, cost/token, turn, cache and recovery outcomes.
